notes.title: Still going, just slowly
notes.content:
Hi All,

I've been away for a while so appologies for not responding to comments and questions in a more timely manner.  One of the recurring questions were, is Magacian's Gambit still being developed?  

Yes.

Just not at the pace that I was aiming for.  Coding Caveman is a one man dev studio and Magician's Gambit is a labour of love for me.  I've put countless hours into developing the game and have no intention of giving up on it.  Unfortunately things happen and the best laid plans of mice and men go awry.

It is already a solid single player VR experience against an incredibly smart AI opponent, but if you are waiting for multiplayer, I'm afraid the wait will be a bit longer than originally anticipated.

I can't currently offer an ETA, I'm afraid, just assuranses that I've not given up on the update.

Best regards,
Coding Caveman
